content.comment_body: I'm attempting to upgrade [product_name] [version_no] to [version_no], but I keep encountering a message asking me to select another extraction location for the installer. Even when I choose the folder where [version_no] is installed, it doesn't work.

Hello [user_name], First, could you specify which operating system you're using? Are you trying to upgrade through the update center in [product_name] or have you downloaded the upgrade from the [company_name] website and are attempting installation via a setup file? Thanks for the information.
I'm running Windows 7 32-bit and downloaded the upgrade from here: [url]. When I try to download the upgrade using the update center, it downloads about 10MB and then stops.

Hello [user_name], When upgrading [product_name] on Windows 7, be sure to run the files as an administrator. I suggest following the instructions in the relevant FAQ documents: - Why does an error appear when installing an update for [product_name] in Windows 7? If the issue persists, try updating manually or via the update center, following these FAQs: - How do you install a downloaded upgrade for [product_name], with or without prior installation? - How do you perform an upgrade, update, or extension via the Update Center in [product_name]? Although these FAQs refer to version [version_no], the installation method applies to upgrades to [version_no] as well. Hopefully, this resolves your problem.
After around 20 attempts to update online, the process finally succeeded. Thank you for your help.

Hi, Another approach is to use the Update Center in [product_name]. Requirements: - A PC with [product_name] [version_no] installed - A compatible PC operating system To proceed, launch [product_name] [version_no], select Help/Update Center, and follow the instructions. Alternative (if installation is blocked): - Insert your [product_name] installation media - On the media, navigate to the Windows folder specific to your operating system (32/64-bit) - Run the main executable directly from the media This allows you to use [product_name] without installation, after which you can follow Help/Update Center steps. Administrative rights are required for all these actions! Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Several users faced issues upgrading [product_name] from [version_no] to [version_no], including installer extraction errors and confusion over the new software distribution method used by [company_name]. The upgrade process was considered cumbersome, with unclear error handling and required multiple attempts for success. There was also uncertainty regarding official download locations, new registration requirements, and export restrictions for accessing the latest version.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a clear, dependable upgrade process for [product_name], understandable error messages, and convenient access to official upgrade files and instructions.
